title: Scaling across direction of difficulty, follows level not at all

design.question: Across direction of difficulty, follows level not at all, how much money does each society need, and does the gap between traditional and OSO grow?
design.compare: 5 societies on 4 difficulties (growth -1, growth 0, growth 2, growth 4)
design.fixed: the simple model: 12 identical agents, equal money each round, a knowledge reward of 1 per new bit, no validation
design.measure: money needed to solve half the targets

answer: To solve half the targets, traditional needs 1.3× to 5.3× the money OSO needs. By difficulty: growth -1 1.3×, growth 0 2.1×, growth 2 5.3×, growth 4 5.0×.
caveats: Read off between the two budgets that bracket half the targets, in log budget.
Each difficulty has its own budget range; "> x" means not reached within it.
